title: SAML2 preflight: IDP certificate rotation simulator + metadata sanity checker
creator: Asha Kumar
description:
Goal: Ship a preflight validation and simulation flow that runs during SAML 2.0 connector setup to detect common metadata mismatch and key-rotation problems before admins finish the wizard. This ticket covers: (1) a simulator that can fetch, parse, and simulate IdP certificate rotation edge cases against the SP metadata we generate; (2) an extensible metadata linting engine (structural + semantic rules) surfaced in the setup flow with clear remediation tips; (3) audit-log hooks and RBAC v2 controls so only Org Admins can run destructive reconciling operations.

Why: We keep seeing onboarding failures triggered by subtle certificate chain changes or attributeName mismatches that only surface after the first real auth attempt. Those failures are high-friction for enterprise customers and cause support tickets and incident escalations. A preflight harness will reduce post-onboarding failures and give operators confidence to rotate keys and change IdP configs safely.

Scope and non-goals:
- In-scope: metadata fetch & validation, certificate chain/expiry checks, signature validation, attribute mappings sanity checks, simulated login using cached SAML request/response template (no live credential exchange), preflight UI feedback with clear remediation guidance, audit log entries for every preflight run and the simulated outcome.
- Out-of-scope for this ticket: automatic metadata reconciliation (separate follow-up), full IdP test-suite (we provide adapters), and federated SCIM provisioning.

Acceptance criteria:
1) CLI/API: Implement a /connectors/:id/preflight endpoint that returns a structured list of issues (severity: info/warning/error) and suggested fixes. Endpoint must also return a reproducible debug bundle link.
2) Simulator: When a connector is in setup mode, the preflight run can simulate a rotated cert scenario by accepting an alternate cert bundle (uploaded or fetched) and show expected validation failure points.
3) UI: Console shows preflight results inline in the SAML setup flow with one-click "copy suggested metadata snippet" and links to Confluence KB articles.
4) RBAC: Only users with role "Organization Admin" or connector owner can trigger reconciliation operations; preflight reads are allowed for Org Admin + Security Admin.
5) Audit: Every preflight execution emits an audit log with fields: user, connector_id, run_id, inputs (redacted), result summary, and timestamp. Logs are retained per org policy and surfaced in Audit UI search.
6) Tests: End-to-end tests that mock IdP responses covering at least: valid metadata, expired cert, missing signing algorithm, attributeName mismatch, and conflicting entityID.

Implementation notes:
- Validation engine: Build on top of existing saml-parser lib, but add a rules layer in Rust/Go service (keep same language as existing connector-service). Rules should be pluggable and versioned to allow future SAML heuristics updates.
- Certificate checks: Validate full chain, expiration window (warn if expiry < 30d), and key usage (signature only). Provide fingerprint and thumbprint variants for RFC-accepted formats.
- Simulator mode: Allow passing an alternate metadata URL or uploading local XML. For security, uploaded bundles are scanned for XML external entity attacks and stored only in ephemeral debug bundles (TTL 7 days).
- Audit & RBAC integration: Use the new RBAC v2 role names and the audit-log producer API. Mark preflight run events with event_type: "saml.preflight.run" and outcome severity.
- UX: Work with Design to present a concise remediation card per issue with 1) why it matters, 2) how to fix it, 3) a one-line sample metadata diff.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge backend + tests behind feature flag preflight.saml2
2) Limited rollout to internal orgs and two pilot customers (pm assigned) for 2 weeks
3) Collect telemetry: preflight pass rates, most common failures, time to resolution
4) Gradual org-wide enablement and deprecation of prior minimal validation flow

Monitoring and telemetry:
- Create dashboard: "SAML preflight metrics" with counts by issue type, per-org failure rates, median time-to-resolve for issues discovered in preflight vs post-onboarding.
- Alert if feature-flagged orgs see >10% preflight false positives in pilot phase.

Security considerations:
- All uploaded metadata and debug bundles must be encrypted at rest and scrubbed from logs.
- Preflight must never perform real authentication or exchange tokens. The simulator uses syntactic/semantic validation and deterministic response templates only.
